_doc: Question activities in the town (story 9.2, services/activityLogic.js, entities/Activities.js, ui/screens/ActivityScreen.js). Each activity is a list of `stages`; a stage asks `n` choice questions of a learning `topic` restricted to the sub-tag `tag` through the learning engine (so every answer is recorded in the kid's learning stats, context `bakery`). pfand: the recycling machine in the market district, a kid counts what the bottles earn (money questions). bakery: ordering and paying at the bakery counter (reached from the bakery shop screen); the kid chooses to order in German (article questions) or in English (vocabulary questions, rewarded `englishMultiplier` times better), then pays (money questions). Rewards: `perCorrectCents` for every right answer (rounded to 5 cents), `allCorrectCents` more when everything was right, and `xpPerCorrect` xp for the kid; `perDay` limits how often one kid can play it a game day (flag activity.<id>.<day>.<player>). Texts: activity.* scan: an English sign (the map `sign` objects with a `board`): walk up, interact, one vocabulary question about signs, once per sign and kid (flag scan.<sign>.<player>, `perSign`). route: the newspaper route from the newsstand, five number-pattern questions, every right answer is a newspaper that lands on the right doorstep (route:hit), once a game day. tramquiz: the map quiz at a tram stop that is not known yet (the first interact there): one geography question (Sachkunde geo); a right answer unlocks the stop for the family (flag tram.stop.<stop>, event tram:unlocked) for fast travel (ui/screens/FastTravelScreen.js).
